name: Philip
summary: One of the seven men chosen to serve the church, later called Philip the evangelist. He preached Christ in Samaria and baptized an Ethiopian official on a desert road.

key_moments.title: Chosen as One of the Seven
key_moments.description: When some widows were being neglected in the daily sharing, the church chose seven trusted men, full of wisdom and the Holy Ghost, to look after it. Philip was one of them, and the apostles prayed and laid their hands on them.

key_moments.title: Preaching in Samaria
key_moments.description: Philip went down to Samaria and preached Christ, and the people listened as they saw the miracles he did. Many men and women believed and were baptized, even Simon the sorcerer.

key_moments.title: Baptizes the Ethiopian
key_moments.description: An angel sent Philip to the desert road toward Gaza, where an Ethiopian official sat in his chariot reading the prophet Isaiah. Philip started from that scripture and preached Jesus to him, then baptized him, and the Spirit carried Philip away.

key_moments.title: Hosts Paul in Caesarea
key_moments.description: When Paul and his company came to Caesarea, they stayed in the house of Philip the evangelist. Philip had four unmarried daughters who prophesied.
